title: Charge Share and Charge Amount Terms by Employer Benefit Charging Class
content:
This schedule sets, for each Employer Benefit Charging class, the wages an employer's charge share is measured against, the precision of the share and of each charge, the program charge shares, and when and how often a payment is charged.

## Share and program terms

| Charge class | Charge share denominator | Wages that make the employer chargeable on a combined wage claim | Regular-program charge share | Extended Benefits charge share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | All base-period wages | Not applicable | 1.00 (the whole) | 0.50 (one half) |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | All base-period wages | Not applicable | 1.00 (the whole) | 0.50 (one half) |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | All base-period wages | Not applicable | 1.00 (the whole) | 0.50 (one half) |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | Base-period wages of all states | Lakeland wages only | 1.00 (the whole) | 0.50 (one half) |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | All base-period wages | Not applicable | 1.00 (the whole) | 0.50 (one half) |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | All base-period wages | Not applicable | 1.00 (the whole) | 0.50 (one half) |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | All base-period wages | Not applicable | 1.00 (the whole) | 1.00 (the whole) |

## Precision, timing and reissues

| Charge class | Charge share precision | Rounding of each charge | Charge posted | Reissued payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Four decimals | Nearest cent | On the payment issue date | Original charge stands; no second charge |

## Notes on the schedule

- The regular-program charge share applies to payments on regular claims, and the Extended Benefits charge share to payments on Extended Benefits claims.
- The only class whose Extended Benefits charge share is the whole (1.00) is Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar; every other class takes one half (0.50) of its proportional part of an Extended Benefits payment.
- The only class measured against the base-period wages of all states is Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer, and for that class only Lakeland wages make a Lakeland employer chargeable.
